claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a task in the biomedical domain that involves recognizing entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs from text.
NER is part of Biomedical Information Extraction, which applies Natural Language Processing techniques to extract relevant information from biomedical literature.
Recent advancements in NER include the use of deep learning techniques, such as recurrent neural networks, to improve performance in biomedical text.
